# MedBook — Corporate Landing Page

## Overview

MedBook is an online healthcare appointment marketplace that connects patients with local doctors, dentists, and specialists. The single-page site should feel **modern, professional, and approachable** — think ZocDoc meets a friendly health brand. The target audience is everyday patients looking to quickly find and book a doctor, so clarity and ease-of-use are paramount. Every design choice should reduce friction and build trust.

## Visual & Style Direction

- **Color palette:** Use a clean, calming primary blue (think `#0066FF` or similar healthcare blue) paired with white backgrounds and light gray sections for contrast. Accent with a warm teal or green for CTAs and success states.
- **Typography:** A modern sans-serif like Inter or similar — large, confident headings with generous whitespace. Body text should be highly readable at 16px+.
- **Mood:** Bright, airy, optimistic. Use soft shadows, rounded corners on cards, and friendly iconography (line icons or simple filled icons for specialties). Avoid anything clinical or sterile — lean into the "playful" part of the tone with subtle micro-interactions and warm illustration-style visuals.

## Key Priorities

1. **The search bar is the hero experience.** It should be visually dominant, immediately communicating "type here to find a doctor." The autocomplete dropdown interaction must feel snappy and intuitive — this is the core conversion moment.
2. **Specialty cards** need to be scannable and inviting — use recognizable icons and clear labels so users can browse at a glance.
3. **Platform stats** should convey scale and trust without feeling like a wall of numbers. Make them visually punchy.
4. **Mobile responsiveness is critical** — the hamburger menu toggle and overall layout must work flawlessly on small screens since many patients search on their phones.

Refer to `task_input.json` for the full structural breakdown of sections, interactions, and data display requirements.

---

## Data Sources

1. Read `/app/benchmark/source_brief.md` for all content materials (text, data).
2. Read `/app/benchmark/task_input.json` for structural requirements, data placement, and interaction definitions.

## Output Requirements

1. Output all files to `/app/output/`. `index.html` must be the main entry point.
2. All pages must be openable directly in a browser (no build step needed). Use relative paths for inter-page links.

## Automated Execution Rules

There is no human operator online for this session. Follow these rules:

1. **Skip all confirmation/approval/user-input steps** — make professional judgments autonomously. Do not pause, ask questions, or wait for replies.
2. **Design decisions** — if `task_input.json` specifies `site.tone`, `site.audience`, etc., use them to choose styles, layouts, and color schemes. Otherwise, make professional judgments.
3. **Priority** — these rules override any interactive-wait instructions in SKILL.md. The skill's workflow, quality standards, and technical specs remain fully effective — only skip interactive waits.

# MedBook — Find and Book Top Doctors Instantly

## Brand
MedBook is an online healthcare appointment marketplace that connects patients with local doctors, dentists, and specialists for easy same-day booking. - **Eye Doctor** — Vision exams, glasses prescriptions, and eye health
- **Orthopedic Surgeon** — Joint pain, fractures, and sports injuries

Each card includes a specialty icon and label. Clicking a card triggers a filtered search for that specialty.

1. **Search for a provider** — Enter your specialty, condition, or doctor name along with your location and insurance. Browse detailed provider profiles with photos, credentials, and office hours.

<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
  <meta charset="UTF-8">
  <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
  <title>MedBook — Find and Book Top Doctors Instantly</title>
  <meta name="description" content="Search thousands of doctors, dentists, and specialists. Read verified patient reviews. Book appointments instantly — even same-day.">
  <link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.googleapis.com">
  <link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.gstatic.com" crossorigin>
  <link href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Inter:wght@400;500;600;700;800;900&display=swap" rel="stylesheet">
  <style>
    *, *::before, *::after { box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0; padding: 0; }

    :root {
      --navy: #1B1464;
      --navy-light: #2a1f8e;
      --navy-dark: #120e45;
      --yellow: #FFD930;
      --yellow-hover: #f0cc1e;
      --yellow-light: #fff8d6;
      --white: #FFFFFF;
      --gray-50: #f8f9fa;
      --gray-100: #f1f3f5;
      --gray-200: #e9ecef;
      --gray-300: #dee2e6;
      --gray-400: #ced4da;
      --gray-500: #adb5bd;
      --gray-600: #868e96;
      --gray-700: #495057;
      --gray-800: #343a40;
      --gray-900: #212529;
      --teal: #0ca678;
      --teal-light: #e6fcf5;
      --shadow-sm: 0 1px 2px rgba(27,20,100,0.05);
      --shadow-md: 0 4px 12px rgba(27,20,100,0.08);
      --shadow-lg: 0 8px 30px rgba(27,20,100,0.12);
      --shadow-xl: 0 16px 48px rgba(27,20,100,0.15);
      --radius: 12px;
      --radius-lg: 16px;
      --radius-xl: 20px;
      --radius-full: 9999px;
      --transition: 0.2s ease;
    }

    html { scroll-behavior: smooth; }

    body {
      font-family: 'Inter', -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif;
      color: var(--gray-800);
      background: var(--white);
      line-height: 1.6;
      font-size: 16px;
      -webkit-font-smoothing: antialiased;
      -moz-osx-font-smoothing: grayscale;
      overflow-x: hidden;
    }

    .container {
      max-width: 1200px;
      margin: 0 auto;
      padding: 0 24px;
    }

    /* ===== HEADER ===== */
    .header {
      position: fixed;
      top: 0;
      left: 0;
      right: 0;
      z-index: 1000;
      background: rgba(255,255,255,0.95);
      backdrop-filter: blur(12px);
      -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(12px);
      border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(27,20,100,0.06);
      transition: box-shadow var(--transition);
    }

    .header.scrolled { box-shadow: var(--shadow-md); }

    .header-inner {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: space-between;
      height: 72px;
    }

    .logo {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 8px;
      text-decoration: none;
      font-weight: 800;
      font-size: 24px;
      color: var(--navy);
      letter-spacing: -0.5px;
    }

    .logo-icon {
      width: 36px;
      height: 36px;
      background: var(--navy);
      border-radius: 10px;
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
      color: var(--yellow);
      font-weight: 900;
      font-size: 18px;
    }

    .nav-desktop { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; }

    .nav-link {
      padding: 8px 16px;
      color: var(--gray-700);
      text-decoration: none;
      font-weight: 500;
      font-size: 15px;
      border-radius: var(--radius);
      transition: all var(--transition);
    }

    .nav-link:hover { color: var(--navy); background: var(--gray-50); }

    .nav-btn-login {
      padding: 8px 20px;
      color: var(--navy);
      text-decoration: none;
      font-weight: 600;
      font-size: 15px;
      border-radius: var(--radius);
      transition: all var(--transition);
    }

    .nav-btn-login:hover { background: var(--gray-50); }

    .nav-btn-signup {
      padding: 8px 20px;
      background: var(--navy);
      color: var(--white);
      text-decoration: none;
      font-weight: 600;
      font-size: 15px;
      border-radius: var(--radius);
      border: none;
      cursor: pointer;
      transition: all var(--transition);
    }

    .nav-btn-signup:hover { background: var(--navy-light); transform: translateY(-1px); }

    .hamburger {
      display: none;
      flex-direction: column;
      gap: 5px;
      background: none;
      border: none;
      cursor: pointer;
      padding: 8px;
      border-radius: 8px;
      transition: background var(--transition);
    }

    .hamburger:hover { background: var(--gray-100); }

    .hamburger span {
      display: block;
      width: 22px;
      height: 2px;
      background: var(--navy);
      border-radius: 2px;
      transition: all 0.3s ease;
    }

    .hamburger.active span:nth-child(1) { transform: rotate(45deg) translate(5px, 5px); }
    .hamburger.active span:nth-child(2) { opacity: 0; }
    .hamburger.active span:nth-child(3) { transform: rotate(-45deg) translate(5px, -5px); }

    /* Mobile drawer */
    .mobile-drawer {
      position: fixed;
      top: 72px;
      right: -100%;
      width: 300px;
      height: calc(100vh - 72px);
      background: var(--white);
      box-shadow: -8px 0 30px rgba(27,20,100,0.15);
      z-index: 999;
      transition: right 0.35s cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1);
      padding: 24px;
      display: flex;
      flex-direction: column;
      gap: 8px;
    }

    .mobile-drawer.open { right: 0; }

    .mobile-overlay {
      position: fixed;
      top: 72px;
      left: 0;
      right: 0;
      bottom: 0;
      background: rgba(27,20,100,0.3);
      z-index: 998;
      opacity: 0;
      pointer-events: none;
      transition: opacity 0.3s ease;
    }

    .mobile-overlay.open { opacity: 1; pointer-events: auto; }

    .mobile-drawer a {
      display: block;
      padding: 14px 16px;
      color: var(--gray-800);
      text-decoration: none;
      font-weight: 500;
      font-size: 16px;
      border-radius: var(--radius);
      transition: all var(--transition);
    }

    .mobile-drawer a:hover { background: var(--gray-50); color: var(--navy); }

    .mobile-drawer .mobile-signup {
      margin-top: 8px;
      background: var(--navy);
      color: var(--white);
      font-weight: 600;
      text-align: center;
    }

    .mobile-drawer .mobile-signup:hover { background: var(--navy-light); }

    /* ===== HERO ===== */
    .hero {
      padding: 140px 0 80px;
      background: linear-gradient(180deg, #f0eeff 0%, var(--white) 100%);
      position: relative;
      overflow: hidden;
    }

    .hero::before {
      content: '';
      position: absolute;
      top: -200px;
      right: -200px;
      width: 500px;
      height: 500px;
      background: radial-gradient(circle, rgba(255,217,48,0.15) 0%, transparent 70%);
      pointer-events: none;
    }

    .hero::after {
      content: '';
      position: absolute;
      bottom: -100px;
      left: -150px;
      width: 400px;
      height: 400px;
      background: radial-gradient(circle, rgba(27,20,100,0.06) 0%, transparent 70%);
      pointer-events: none;
    }

    .hero-content {
      text-align: center;
      max-width: 720px;
      margin: 0 auto;
      position: relative;
      z-index: 1;
    }

    .hero-badge {
      display: inline-flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 6px;
      padding: 6px 16px;
      background: var(--yellow-light);
      color: var(--navy);
      font-weight: 600;
      font-size: 13px;
      border-radius: var(--radius-full);
      margin-bottom: 24px;
      letter-spacing: 0.02em;
    }

    .hero h1 {
      font-size: clamp(36px, 5vw, 56px);
      font-weight: 900;
      color: var(--navy);
      line-height: 1.1;
      letter-spacing: -1.5px;
      margin-bottom: 20px;
    }

    .hero p {
      font-size: clamp(16px, 2vw, 19px);
      color: var(--gray-600);
      line-height: 1.7;
      max-width: 580px;
      margin: 0 auto 40px;
    }

    /* ===== SEARCH BAR ===== */
    .search-wrapper {
      max-width: 800px;
      margin: 0 auto;
      position: relative;
      z-index: 10;
    }

    .search-bar {
      display: flex;
      align-items: stretch;
      background: var(--white);
      border-radius: var(--radius-lg);
      box-shadow: var(--shadow-xl);
      border: 2px solid transparent;
      transition: border-color var(--transition), box-shadow var(--transition);
      overflow: visible;
      position: relative;
    }

    .search-bar:focus-within {
      border-color: var(--navy);
      box-shadow: var(--shadow-xl), 0 0 0 4px rgba(27,20,100,0.08);
    }

    .search-field {
      flex: 1;
      position: relative;
      min-width: 0;
    }

    .search-field + .search-field { border-left: 1px solid var(--gray-200); }

    .search-field label {
      position: absolute;
      top: 12px;
      left: 48px;
      font-size: 11px;
      font-weight: 700;
      color: var(--navy);
      text-transform: uppercase;
      letter-spacing: 0.06em;
    }

    .search-field .field-icon {
      position: absolute;
      left: 16px;
      top: 50%;
      transform: translateY(-50%);
      width: 20px;
      height: 20px;
      color: var(--gray-400);
    }

    .search-field input,
    .search-field select {
      width: 100%;
      height: 72px;
      padding: 30px 16px 10px 48px;
      border: none;
      background: transparent;
      font-size: 15px;
      font-family: inherit;
      color: var(--gray-800);
      outline: none;
    }

    .search-field input::placeholder,
    .search-field select { color: var(--gray-400); }

    .search-field select {
      appearance: none;
      cursor: pointer;
      color: var(--gray-400);
    }

    .search-field select:valid { color: var(--gray-800); }

    .search-btn {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 8px;
      padding: 0 28px;
      background: var(--yellow);
      color: var(--navy);
      border: none;
      font-weight: 700;
      font-size: 16px;
      font-family: inherit;
      cursor: pointer;
      border-radius: 0 14px 14px 0;
      transition: all var(--transition);
      white-space: nowrap;
    }

    .search-btn:hover { background: var(--yellow-hover); }
    .search-btn:active { transform: scale(0.98); }

    .search-btn svg { width: 20px; height: 20px; }

    /* Autocomplete dropdown */
    .autocomplete-dropdown {
      position: absolute;
      top: calc(100% + 4px);
      left: 0;
      right: 0;
      background: var(--white);
      border-radius: var(--radius);
      box-shadow: var(--shadow-lg);
      border: 1px solid var(--gray-200);
      display: none;
      z-index: 20;
      overflow: hidden;
      max-height: 280px;
      overflow-y: auto;
    }

    .autocomplete-dropdown.show { display: block; animation: fadeDown 0.15s ease; }

    @keyframes fadeDown {
      from { opacity: 0; transform: translateY(-4px); }
      to { opacity: 1; transform: translateY(0); }
    }

    .autocomplete-item {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 12px;
      padding: 12px 16px;
      cursor: pointer;
      transition: background var(--transition);
      font-size: 14px;
    }

    .autocomplete-item:hover { background: var(--gray-50); }

    .autocomplete-item .item-icon {
      width: 32px;
      height: 32px;
      border-radius: 8px;
      background: var(--gray-100);
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
      color: var(--navy);
      font-size: 14px;
      flex-shrink: 0;
    }

    .autocomplete-item .item-label { font-weight: 500; color: var(--gray-800); }
    .autocomplete-item .item-type { font-size: 12px; color: var(--gray-500); margin-top: 1px; }

    .search-hint {
      text-align: center;
      margin-top: 16px;
      font-size: 13px;
      color: var(--gray-500);
    }

    .search-hint strong { color: var(--gray-700); font-weight: 600; }

    /* ===== SPECIALTIES ===== */
    .specialties {
      padding: 80px 0;
      background: var(--white);
    }

    .section-header {
      text-align: center;
      margin-bottom: 48px;
    }

    .section-label {
      display: inline-block;
      font-size: 13px;
      font-weight: 700;
      color: var(--navy);
      text-transform: uppercase;
      letter-spacing: 0.08em;
      margin-bottom: 12px;
      background: rgba(27,20,100,0.06);
      padding: 4px 14px;
      border-radius: var(--radius-full);
    }

    .section-title {
      font-size: clamp(28px, 3.5vw, 40px);
      font-weight: 800;
      color: var(--navy);
      letter-spacing: -0.8px;
      line-height: 1.2;
      margin-bottom: 12px;
    }

    .section-subtitle {
      font-size: 17px;
      color: var(--gray-600);
      max-width: 520px;
      margin: 0 auto;
    }

    .specialties-grid {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 1fr);
      gap: 20px;
    }

    .specialty-card {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 16px;
      padding: 24px;
      background: var(--white);
      border: 1px solid var(--gray-200);
      border-radius: var(--radius-lg);
      cursor: pointer;
      transition: all var(--transition);

    }

    .specialty-icon {

      height: 56px;

    .specialty-card:nth-child(4) .specialty-icon { background: #f3e8ff; }

      drawer.classList.remove('open');
      overlay.classList.remove('open');
      hamburger.setAttribute('aria-expanded', 'false');
      document.body.style.overflow = '';
    }

    hamburger.addEventListener('click', () => {
      const isOpen = drawer.classList.toggle('open');
      hamburger.classList.toggle('active');
      overlay.classList.toggle('open');
      hamburger.setAttribute('aria-expanded', isOpen);
      document.body.style.overflow = isOpen ? 'hidden' : '';
    });

    overlay.addEventListener('click', closeMenu);

    // Header scroll effect
    const header = document.getElementById('header');
    window.addEventListener('scroll', () => {
      header.classList.toggle('scrolled', window.scrollY > 10);
    }, { passive: true });

    // Autocomplete
    const specialtyInput = document.getElementById('specialty');
    const dropdown = document.getElementById('specialtyDropdown');

    const suggestions = [
      { label: 'Primary Care', type: 'Specialty', icon: '♥' },
      { label: 'Dentist', type: 'Specialty', icon: '☺' },
      { label: 'Dermatologist', type: 'Specialty', icon: '✦' },
      { label: 'Psychiatrist', type: 'Specialty', icon: '☾' },
      { label: 'Eye Doctor', type: 'Specialty', icon: '◉' },
      { label: 'Orthopedic Surgeon', type: 'Specialty', icon: '✚' },
      { label: 'Cardiologist', type: 'Specialty', icon: '♥' },
      { label: 'Back pain', type: 'Condition', icon: '⛟' },
      { label: 'Headache', type: 'Condition', icon: '⛟' },
      { label: 'Skin rash', type: 'Condition', icon: '⛟' },
      { label: 'Dr. Sarah Chen', type: 'Doctor', icon: '⚗' },
      { label: 'Dr. Michael Ross', type: 'Doctor', icon: '⚗' },
    ];

    specialtyInput.addEventListener('input', () => {
      const val = specialtyInput.value.toLowerCase().trim();
      if (!val) { dropdown.classList.remove('show'); return; }

      const filtered = suggestions.filter(s => s.label.toLowerCase().includes(val));
      if (!filtered.length) { dropdown.classList.remove('show'); return; }

      dropdown.innerHTML = filtered.map(s => `
        <div class="autocomplete-item" data-value="${s.label}">
          <div class="item-icon">${s.icon}</div>
          <div>
            <div class="item-label">${s.label}</div>
            <div class="item-type">${s.type}</div>
          </div>
        </div>
      `).join('');

      dropdown.classList.add('show');
    });

    dropdown.addEventListener('click', (e) => {
      const item = e.target.closest('.autocomplete-item');
      if (item) {
        specialtyInput.value = item.dataset.value;
        dropdown.classList.remove('show');
      }
    });

      if (!e.target.closest('.search-field')) dropdown.classList.remove('show');
    });

    specialtyInput.addEventListener('keydown', (e) => {
      if (e.key === 'Escape') dropdown.classList.remove('show');
    });

      card.addEventListener('click', (e) => {
        e.preventDefault();
        const specialty = card.dataset.specialty;

      entries.forEach((entry, i) => {
        if (entry.isIntersecting) {

          observer.unobserve(entry.target);
        }
      });
    }, { threshold: 0.15, rootMargin: '0px 0px -40px 0px' });

    fadeEls.forEach(el => observer.observe(el));

    .specialty-card {

    .step-card { text-align: center; position: relative; z-index: 1; }

    .step-number {

    .stats-grid {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: repeat(4, 1fr);
      gap: 32px;
      text-align: center;
      position: relative;
      z-index: 1;
    }

    .stat-item {}

    .stat-value {
      font-size: clamp(32px, 4vw, 44px);
      font-weight: 900;
      color: var(--yellow);
      letter-spacing: -1px;
      line-height: 1;
      margin-bottom: 8px;
    }

    .stat-label {
      font-size: 15px;
      color: rgba(255,255,255,0.75);
      font-weight: 500;
    }

    /* ===== TESTIMONIALS ===== */
    .testimonials {
      padding: 80px 0;
      background: var(--white);
    }

    .testimonials-grid {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 1fr);
      gap: 24px;
    }

    .testimonial-card {
      padding: 32px;
      background: var(--white);
      border: 1px solid var(--gray-200);
      border-radius: var(--radius-lg);
      transition: all var(--transition);
    }

    .testimonial-card:hover {
      box-shadow: var(--shadow-lg);
      transform: translateY(-3px);
    }

    .testimonial-stars {
      display: flex;
      gap: 2px;
      margin-bottom: 16px;
    }

    .testimonial-stars svg { width: 18px; height: 18px; color: var(--yellow); fill: var(--yellow); }

    .testimonial-text {
      font-size: 15px;
      color: var(--gray-700);
      line-height: 1.7;
      margin-bottom: 20px;
      font-style: italic;
    }

    .testimonial-author {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 12px;
    }

    .testimonial-avatar {
      width: 44px;
      height: 44px;
      border-radius: 50%;
      background: var(--navy);
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
      color: var(--yellow);
      font-weight: 700;
      font-size: 16px;
    }

    .testimonial-name {
      font-weight: 700;
      font-size: 15px;
      color: var(--navy);
    }

    .testimonial-location {
      font-size: 13px;
      color: var(--gray-500);
    }

    /* ===== MOBILE APP PROMO ===== */
    .app-promo {
      padding: 80px 0;
      background: var(--gray-50);
    }

    .app-promo-inner {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 64px;
    }

    .app-promo-content { flex: 1; }

    .app-promo-content h2 {
      font-size: clamp(28px, 3.5vw, 40px);
      font-weight: 800;
      color: var(--navy);
      letter-spacing: -0.8px;
      margin-bottom: 16px;
    }

    .app-promo-content > p {
      font-size: 17px;
      color: var(--gray-600);
      margin-bottom: 32px;
      line-height: 1.7;
      max-width: 460px;
    }

    .app-features {
      list-style: none;
      margin-bottom: 36px;
      display: grid;
      gap: 14px;
    }

    .app-features li {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 12px;
      font-size: 15px;
      color: var(--gray-700);
      font-weight: 500;
    }

    .app-features li svg {
      width: 22px;
      height: 22px;
      color: var(--teal);
      flex-shrink: 0;
    }

    .app-buttons {
      display: flex;
      gap: 12px;
      flex-wrap: wrap;
    }

    .app-btn {
      display: inline-flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 10px;
      padding: 12px 24px;
      background: var(--navy);
      color: var(--white);
      border-radius: var(--radius);
      text-decoration: none;
      font-weight: 600;
      font-size: 14px;
      transition: all var(--transition);
    }

    .app-btn:hover { background: var(--navy-light); transform: translateY(-1px); }

    .app-promo-visual {

    .phone-mockup {

      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;

    .phone-content {

      padding: 20px 16px;
      display: flex;
      flex-direction: column;

      color: var(--gray-500);

    .phone-title {

    .phone-search-bar {

      align-items: center;

      text-align: center;

    .footer-col a {
      display: block;
      color: rgba(255,255,255,0.6);
      text-decoration: none;

    .footer-bottom {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: space-between;
      padding: 24px 0;
      font-size: 13px;
      color: rgba(255,255,255,0.4);

    @media (max-width: 1024px) {

    @media (max-width: 768px) {

      .search-field input,
      .search-field select { height: 60px; }

      .search-btn {
        border-radius: 0 0 14px 14px;

        padding: 16px;

        text-align: center;

      .app-promo-content > p { margin-left: auto; margin-right: auto; }
      .app-features { text-align: left; }
      .app-buttons { justify-content: center; }

      .footer-grid { grid-template-columns: repeat(2, 1fr); }
      .footer-brand { grid-column: 1 / -1; }

    @media (max-width: 480px) {
      .container { padding: 0 16px; }
      .specialties-grid { grid-template-columns: 1fr; }
      .stats-grid { grid-template-columns: 1fr; }
      .footer-grid { grid-template-columns: 1fr; }
      .app-promo-visual { flex: none; width: 100%; }
      .phone-mockup { width: 240px; height: 480px; }
    }

    /* ===== ANIMATIONS ===== */
    .fade-up {
      opacity: 0;
      transform: translateY(24px);
      transition: opacity 0.6s ease, transform 0.6s ease;
    }

    .fade-up.visible {
      opacity: 1;
      transform: translateY(0);
    }

    @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) {
      .fade-up { opacity: 1; transform: none; transition: none; }
      html { scroll-behavior: auto; }
    }

  <script>
    // Mobile menu toggle
    const hamburger = document.getElementById('hamburger');
    const drawer = document.getElementById('mobileDrawer');
    const overlay = document.getElementById('mobileOverlay');

    function closeMenu() {
      hamburger.classList.remove('active');
      drawer.classList.remove('open');
      overlay.classList.remove('open');
      hamburger.setAttribute('aria-expanded', 'false');
      document.body.style.overflow = '';
    }

    hamburger.addEventListener('click', () => {
      const isOpen = drawer.classList.toggle('open');
      hamburger.classList.toggle('active');
      overlay.classList.toggle('open');
      hamburger.setAttribute('aria-expanded', isOpen);
      document.body.style.overflow = isOpen ? 'hidden' : '';
    });

    overlay.addEventListener('click', closeMenu);

    // Header scroll effect
    const header = document.getElementById('header');
    window.addEventListener('scroll', () => {
      header.classList.toggle('scrolled', window.scrollY > 10);
    }, { passive: true });

    // Autocomplete
    const specialtyInput = document.getElementById('specialty');
    const dropdown = document.getElementById('specialtyDropdown');

    const suggestions = [
      { label: 'Primary Care', type: 'Specialty', icon: '♥' },
      { label: 'Dentist', type: 'Specialty', icon: '☺' },
      { label: 'Dermatologist', type: 'Specialty', icon: '✦' },
      { label: 'Psychiatrist', type: 'Specialty', icon: '☾' },
      { label: 'Eye Doctor', type: 'Specialty', icon: '◉' },
      { label: 'Orthopedic Surgeon', type: 'Specialty', icon: '✚' },
      { label: 'Cardiologist', type: 'Specialty', icon: '♥' },
      { label: 'Back pain', type: 'Condition', icon: '⛟' },
      { label: 'Headache', type: 'Condition', icon: '⛟' },
      { label: 'Skin rash', type: 'Condition', icon: '⛟' },
      { label: 'Dr. Sarah Chen', type: 'Doctor', icon: '⚗' },
      { label: 'Dr. Michael Ross', type: 'Doctor', icon: '⚗' },
    ];

    specialtyInput.addEventListener('input', () => {
      const val = specialtyInput.value.toLowerCase().trim();
      if (!val) { dropdown.classList.remove('show'); return; }

      const filtered = suggestions.filter(s => s.label.toLowerCase().includes(val));
      if (!filtered.length) { dropdown.classList.remove('show'); return; }

      dropdown.innerHTML = filtered.map(s => `
        <div class="autocomplete-item" data-value="${s.label}">
          <div class="item-icon">${s.icon}</div>
          <div>
            <div class="item-label">${s.label}</div>
            <div class="item-type">${s.type}</div>
          </div>
        </div>
      `).join('');

      dropdown.classList.add('show');
    });

    dropdown.addEventListener('click', (e) => {
      const item = e.target.closest('.autocomplete-item');
      if (item) {
        specialtyInput.value = item.dataset.value;
        dropdown.classList.remove('show');
      }
    });

    document.addEventListener('click', (e) => {
      if (!e.target.closest('.search-field')) dropdown.classList.remove('show');
    });

    // Close autocomplete on Escape
    specialtyInput.addEventListener('keydown', (e) => {
      if (e.key === 'Escape') dropdown.classList.remove('show');
    });

    // Specialty card click
    document.querySelectorAll('.specialty-card').forEach(card => {
      card.addEventListener('click', (e) => {
        e.preventDefault();
        const specialty = card.dataset.specialty;
        specialtyInput.value = specialty;
        window.scrollTo({ top: 0, behavior: 'smooth' });
        setTimeout(() => specialtyInput.focus(), 600);
      });
    });

    // Scroll animations
    const fadeEls = document.querySelectorAll('.fade-up');
    const observer = new IntersectionObserver((entries) => {
      entries.forEach((entry, i) => {
        if (entry.isIntersecting) {
          setTimeout(() => entry.target.classList.add('visible'), i * 80);
          observer.unobserve(entry.target);
        }
      });
    }, { threshold: 0.15, rootMargin: '0px 0px -40px 0px' });

    fadeEls.forEach(el => observer.observe(el));
  </script>

  <style>
    *, *::before, *::after { box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0; padding: 0; }

    :root {
      --navy: #1B1464;
      --navy-light: #2a1f8e;
      --navy-dark: #120e45;
      --yellow: #FFD930;
      --yellow-hover: #f0cc1e;
      --yellow-light: #fff8d6;
      --white: #FFFFFF;
      --gray-50: #f8f9fa;
      --gray-100: #f1f3f5;
      --gray-200: #e9ecef;
      --gray-300: #dee2e6;
      --gray-400: #ced4da;
      --gray-500: #adb5bd;
      --gray-600: #868e96;
      --gray-700: #495057;
      --gray-800: #343a40;
      --gray-900: #212529;
      --teal: #0ca678;
      --teal-light: #e6fcf5;
      --shadow-sm: 0 1px 2px rgba(27,20,100,0.05);
      --shadow-md: 0 4px 12px rgba(27,20,100,0.08);
      --shadow-lg: 0 8px 30px rgba(27,20,100,0.12);
      --shadow-xl: 0 16px 48px rgba(27,20,100,0.15);
      --radius: 12px;
      --radius-lg: 16px;
      --radius-xl: 20px;
      --radius-full: 9999px;
      --transition: 0.2s ease;
    }

    html { scroll-behavior: smooth; }

    body {
      font-family: 'Inter', -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif;
      color: var(--gray-800);
      background: var(--white);
      line-height: 1.6;
      font-size: 16px;
      -webkit-font-smoothing: antialiased;
      -moz-osx-font-smoothing: grayscale;
      overflow-x: hidden;
    }

    .container {
      max-width: 1200px;
      margin: 0 auto;
      padding: 0 24px;
    }

    /* ===== HEADER ===== */
    .header {
      position: fixed;
      top: 0;
      left: 0;
      right: 0;
      z-index: 1000;
      background: rgba(255,255,255,0.95);
      backdrop-filter: blur(12px);
      -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(12px);
      border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(27,20,100,0.06);
      transition: box-shadow var(--transition);
    }

    .header.scrolled { box-shadow: var(--shadow-md); }

    .header-inner {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: space-between;
      height: 72px;
    }

    .logo {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 8px;
      text-decoration: none;
      font-weight: 800;
      font-size: 24px;
      color: var(--navy);
      letter-spacing: -0.5px;
    }

    .logo-icon {
      width: 36px;
      height: 36px;
      background: var(--navy);
      border-radius: 10px;
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
      color: var(--yellow);
      font-weight: 900;
      font-size: 18px;
    }

    .nav-desktop { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; }

    .nav-link {
      padding: 8px 16px;
      color: var(--gray-700);
      text-decoration: none;
      font-weight: 500;
      font-size: 15px;
      border-radius: var(--radius);
      transition: all var(--transition);
    }

    .nav-link:hover { color: var(--navy); background: var(--gray-50); }

    .nav-btn-login {
      padding: 8px 20px;
      color: var(--navy);
      text-decoration: none;
      font-weight: 600;
      font-size: 15px;
      border-radius: var(--radius);
      transition: all var(--transition);
    }

    .nav-btn-login:hover { background: var(--gray-50); }

    .nav-btn-signup {
      padding: 8px 20px;
      background: var(--navy);
      color: var(--white);
      text-decoration: none;
      font-weight: 600;
      font-size: 15px;
      border-radius: var(--radius);
      border: none;
      cursor: pointer;
      transition: all var(--transition);
    }

    .nav-btn-signup:hover { background: var(--navy-light); transform: translateY(-1px); }

    .hamburger {
      display: none;
      flex-direction: column;
      gap: 5px;
      background: none;
      border: none;
      cursor: pointer;
      padding: 8px;
      border-radius: 8px;
      transition: background var(--transition);
    }

    .hamburger:hover { background: var(--gray-100); }

    .hamburger span {
      display: block;
      width: 22px;
      height: 2px;
      background: var(--navy);
      border-radius: 2px;
      transition: all 0.3s ease;
    }

    .hamburger.active span:nth-child(1) { transform: rotate(45deg) translate(5px, 5px); }
    .hamburger.active span:nth-child(2) { opacity: 0; }
    .hamburger.active span:nth-child(3) { transform: rotate(-45deg) translate(5px, -5px); }

    /* Mobile drawer */
    .mobile-drawer {
      position: fixed;
      top: 72px;
      right: -100%;
      width: 300px;
      height: calc(100vh - 72px);
      background: var(--white);
      box-shadow: -8px 0 30px rgba(27,20,100,0.15);
      z-index: 999;
      transition: right 0.35s cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1);
      padding: 24px;
      display: flex;
      flex-direction: column;
      gap: 8px;
    }

    .mobile-drawer.open { right: 0; }

    .mobile-overlay {
      position: fixed;
      top: 72px;
      left: 0;
      right: 0;
      bottom: 0;
      background: rgba(27,20,100,0.3);
      z-index: 998;
      opacity: 0;
      pointer-events: none;
      transition: opacity 0.3s ease;
    }

    .mobile-overlay.open { opacity: 1; pointer-events: auto; }

    .mobile-drawer a {
      display: block;
      padding: 14px 16px;
      color: var(--gray-800);
      text-decoration: none;
      font-weight: 500;
      font-size: 16px;
      border-radius: var(--radius);
      transition: all var(--transition);
    }

    .mobile-drawer a:hover { background: var(--gray-50); color: var(--navy); }

    .mobile-drawer .mobile-signup {
      margin-top: 8px;
      background: var(--navy);
      color: var(--white);
      font-weight: 600;
      text-align: center;
    }

    .mobile-drawer .mobile-signup:hover { background: var(--navy-light); }

    /* ===== HERO ===== */
    .hero {
      padding: 140px 0 80px;
      background: linear-gradient(180deg, #f0eeff 0%, var(--white) 100%);
      position: relative;
      overflow: hidden;
    }

    .hero::before {
      content: '';
      position: absolute;
      top: -200px;
      right: -200px;
      width: 500px;
      height: 500px;
      background: radial-gradient(circle, rgba(255,217,48,0.15) 0%, transparent 70%);
      pointer-events: none;
    }

    .hero::after {
      content: '';
      position: absolute;
      bottom: -100px;
      left: -150px;
      width: 400px;
      height: 400px;
      background: radial-gradient(circle, rgba(27,20,100,0.06) 0%, transparent 70%);
      pointer-events: none;
    }

    .hero-content {
      text-align: center;
      max-width: 720px;
      margin: 0 auto;
      position: relative;
      z-index: 1;
    }

    .hero-badge {
      display: inline-flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 6px;
      padding: 6px 16px;
      background: var(--yellow-light);
      color: var(--navy);
      font-weight: 600;
      font-size: 13px;
      border-radius: var(--radius-full);
      margin-bottom: 24px;
      letter-spacing: 0.02em;
    }

    .hero h1 {
      font-size: clamp(36px, 5vw, 56px);
      font-weight: 900;
      color: var(--navy);
      line-height: 1.1;
      letter-spacing: -1.5px;
      margin-bottom: 20px;
    }

    .hero p {
      font-size: clamp(16px, 2vw, 19px);
      color: var(--gray-600);
      line-height: 1.7;
      max-width: 580px;
      margin: 0 auto 40px;
    }

    /* ===== SEARCH BAR ===== */
    .search-wrapper {
      max-width: 800px;
      margin: 0 auto;
      position: relative;
      z-index: 10;
    }

    .search-bar {
      display: flex;
      align-items: stretch;
      background: var(--white);
      border-radius: var(--radius-lg);
      box-shadow: var(--shadow-xl);
      border: 2px solid transparent;
      transition: border-color var(--transition), box-shadow var(--transition);
      overflow: visible;
      position: relative;
    }

    .search-bar:focus-within {
      border-color: var(--navy);
      box-shadow: var(--shadow-xl), 0 0 0 4px rgba(27,20,100,0.08);
    }

    .search-field {
      flex: 1;
      position: relative;
      min-width: 0;
    }

    .search-field + .search-field { border-left: 1px solid var(--gray-200); }

    .search-field label {
      position: absolute;
      top: 12px;
      left: 48px;
      font-size: 11px;
      font-weight: 700;
      color: var(--navy);
      text-transform: uppercase;
      letter-spacing: 0.06em;
    }

    .search-field .field-icon {
      position: absolute;
      left: 16px;
      top: 50%;
      transform: translateY(-50%);
      width: 20px;
      height: 20px;
      color: var(--gray-400);
    }

    .search-field input,
    .search-field select {
      width: 100%;
      height: 72px;
      padding: 30px 16px 10px 48px;
      border: none;
      background: transparent;
      font-size: 15px;
      font-family: inherit;
      color: var(--gray-800);
      outline: none;
    }

    .search-field input::placeholder,
    .search-field select { color: var(--gray-400); }

    .search-field select {
      appearance: none;
      cursor: pointer;
      color: var(--gray-400);
    }

    .search-field select:valid { color: var(--gray-800); }

    .search-btn {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 8px;
      padding: 0 28px;
      background: var(--yellow);
      color: var(--navy);
      border: none;
      font-weight: 700;
      font-size: 16px;
      font-family: inherit;
      cursor: pointer;
      border-radius: 0 14px 14px 0;
      transition: all var(--transition);
      white-space: nowrap;
    }

    .search-btn:hover { background: var(--yellow-hover); }
    .search-btn:active { transform: scale(0.98); }

    .search-btn svg { width: 20px; height: 20px; }

    /* Autocomplete dropdown */
    .autocomplete-dropdown {
      position: absolute;
      top: calc(100% + 4px);
      left: 0;
      right: 0;
      background: var(--white);
      border-radius: var(--radius);
      box-shadow: var(--shadow-lg);
      border: 1px solid var(--gray-200);
      display: none;
      z-index: 20;
      overflow: hidden;
      max-height: 280px;
      overflow-y: auto;
    }

    .autocomplete-dropdown.show { display: block; animation: fadeDown 0.15s ease; }

    @keyframes fadeDown {
      from { opacity: 0; transform: translateY(-4px); }
      to { opacity: 1; transform: translateY(0); }
    }

    .autocomplete-item {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 12px;
      padding: 12px 16px;
      cursor: pointer;
      transition: background var(--transition);
      font-size: 14px;
    }

    .autocomplete-item:hover { background: var(--gray-50); }

    .autocomplete-item .item-icon {
      width: 32px;
      height: 32px;
      border-radius: 8px;
      background: var(--gray-100);
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
      color: var(--navy);
      font-size: 14px;
      flex-shrink: 0;
    }

    .autocomplete-item .item-label { font-weight: 500; color: var(--gray-800); }
    .autocomplete-item .item-type { font-size: 12px; color: var(--gray-500); margin-top: 1px; }

    .search-hint {
      text-align: center;
      margin-top: 16px;
      font-size: 13px;
      color: var(--gray-500);
    }

    .search-hint strong { color: var(--gray-700); font-weight: 600; }

    /* ===== SPECIALTIES ===== */
    .specialties {
      padding: 80px 0;
      background: var(--white);
    }

    .section-header {
      text-align: center;
      margin-bottom: 48px;
    }

    .section-label {
      display: inline-block;
      font-size: 13px;
      font-weight: 700;
      color: var(--navy);
      text-transform: uppercase;
      letter-spacing: 0.08em;
      margin-bottom: 12px;
      background: rgba(27,20,100,0.06);
      padding: 4px 14px;
      border-radius: var(--radius-full);
    }

    .section-title {
      font-size: clamp(28px, 3.5vw, 40px);
      font-weight: 800;
      color: var(--navy);
      letter-spacing: -0.8px;
      line-height: 1.2;
      margin-bottom: 12px;
    }

    .section-subtitle {
      font-size: 17px;
      color: var(--gray-600);
      max-width: 520px;
      margin: 0 auto;
    }

    .specialties-grid {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 1fr);
      gap: 20px;
    }

    .specialty-card {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 16px;
      padding: 24px;
      background: var(--white);
      border: 1px solid var(--gray-200);
      border-radius: var(--radius-lg);
      cursor: pointer;
      transition: all var(--transition);
      text-decoration: none;
      color: inherit;
    }

    .specialty-card:hover {
      border-color: var(--navy);
      box-shadow: var(--shadow-md);
      transform: translateY(-2px);
    }

    .specialty-icon {
      width: 56px;
      height: 56px;
      border-radius: var(--radius);
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
      font-size: 26px;
      flex-shrink: 0;
    }

    .specialty-card:nth-child(1) .specialty-icon { background: #e8f4fd; }
    .specialty-card:nth-child(2) .specialty-icon { background: #e6fcf5; }
    .specialty-card:nth-child(3) .specialty-icon { background: #fff3e6; }
    .specialty-card:nth-child(4) .specialty-icon { background: #f3e8ff; }
    .specialty-card:nth-child(5) .specialty-icon { background: #e8f0fe; }
    .specialty-card:nth-child(6) .specialty-icon { background: #fce8e8; }

    .specialty-name {
      font-weight: 700;
      font-size: 16px;
      color: var(--navy);
      margin-bottom: 4px;
    }

    .specialty-desc {
      font-size: 13px;
      color: var(--gray-500);
      line-height: 1.4;
    }

    /* ===== HOW IT WORKS ===== */
    .how-it-works {
      padding: 80px 0;
      background: var(--gray-50);
    }

    .steps-grid {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 1fr);
      gap: 32px;
      position: relative;
    }

    .steps-grid::before {
      content: '';
      position: absolute;
      top: 40px;
      left: calc(16.67% + 24px);
      right: calc(16.67% + 24px);
      height: 2px;
      background: linear-gradient(90deg, var(--yellow) 0%, var(--navy) 100%);
      opacity: 0.3;
    }

    .step-card { text-align: center; position: relative; z-index: 1; }

    .step-number {
      width: 80px;
      height: 80px;
      border-radius: 50%;
      background: var(--white);
      border: 3px solid var(--yellow);
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
      margin: 0 auto 24px;
      font-weight: 800;
      font-size: 28px;
      color: var(--navy);
      box-shadow: var(--shadow-md);
      transition: all 0.3s ease;
    }

    .step-card:hover .step-number {
      background: var(--yellow);
      transform: scale(1.08);
    }

    .step-title {
      font-size: 20px;
      font-weight: 700;
      color: var(--navy);
      margin-bottom: 12px;
    }

    .step-text {
      font-size: 15px;
      color: var(--gray-600);
      line-height: 1.6;
      max-width: 300px;
      margin: 0 auto;
    }

    /* ===== STATS ===== */
    .stats {
      padding: 60px 0;
      background: var(--navy);
      position: relative;
      overflow: hidden;
    }

    .stats::before {
      content: '';
      position: absolute;
      top: -50%;
      right: -10%;
      width: 400px;
      height: 400px;
      background: radial-gradient(circle, rgba(255,217,48,0.12) 0%, transparent 70%);
      pointer-events: none;
    }

    .stats-grid {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: repeat(4, 1fr);
      gap: 32px;
      text-align: center;
      position: relative;
      z-index: 1;
    }

    .stat-item {}

    .stat-value {
      font-size: clamp(32px, 4vw, 44px);
      font-weight: 900;
      color: var(--yellow);
      letter-spacing: -1px;
      line-height: 1;
      margin-bottom: 8px;
    }

    .stat-label {
      font-size: 15px;
      color: rgba(255,255,255,0.75);
      font-weight: 500;
    }

    /* ===== TESTIMONIALS ===== */
    .testimonials {
      padding: 80px 0;
      background: var(--white);
    }

    .testimonials-grid {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 1fr);
      gap: 24px;
    }

    .testimonial-card {
      padding: 32px;
      background: var(--white);
      border: 1px solid var(--gray-200);
      border-radius: var(--radius-lg);
      transition: all var(--transition);
    }

    .testimonial-card:hover {
      box-shadow: var(--shadow-lg);
      transform: translateY(-3px);
    }

    .testimonial-stars {
      display: flex;
      gap: 2px;
      margin-bottom: 16px;
    }

    .testimonial-stars svg { width: 18px; height: 18px; color: var(--yellow); fill: var(--yellow); }

    .testimonial-text {
      font-size: 15px;
      color: var(--gray-700);
      line-height: 1.7;
      margin-bottom: 20px;
      font-style: italic;
    }

    .testimonial-author {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 12px;
    }

    .testimonial-avatar {
      width: 44px;
      height: 44px;
      border-radius: 50%;
      background: var(--navy);
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
      color: var(--yellow);
      font-weight: 700;
      font-size: 16px;
    }

    .testimonial-name {
      font-weight: 700;
      font-size: 15px;
      color: var(--navy);
    }

    .testimonial-location {
      font-size: 13px;
      color: var(--gray-500);
    }

    /* ===== MOBILE APP PROMO ===== */
    .app-promo {
      padding: 80px 0;
      background: var(--gray-50);
    }

    .app-promo-inner {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 64px;
    }

    .app-promo-content { flex: 1; }

    .app-promo-content h2 {
      font-size: clamp(28px, 3.5vw, 40px);
      font-weight: 800;
      color: var(--navy);
      letter-spacing: -0.8px;
      margin-bottom: 16px;
    }

    .app-promo-content > p {
      font-size: 17px;
      color: var(--gray-600);
      margin-bottom: 32px;
      line-height: 1.7;
      max-width: 460px;
    }

    .app-features {
      list-style: none;
      margin-bottom: 36px;
      display: grid;
      gap: 14px;
    }

    .app-features li {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 12px;
      font-size: 15px;
      color: var(--gray-700);
      font-weight: 500;
    }

    .app-features li svg {
      width: 22px;
      height: 22px;
      color: var(--teal);
      flex-shrink: 0;
    }

    .app-buttons {
      display: flex;
      gap: 12px;
      flex-wrap: wrap;
    }

    .app-btn {
      display: inline-flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 10px;
      padding: 12px 24px;
      background: var(--navy);
      color: var(--white);
      border-radius: var(--radius);
      text-decoration: none;
      font-weight: 600;
      font-size: 14px;
      transition: all var(--transition);
    }

    .app-btn:hover { background: var(--navy-light); transform: translateY(-1px); }
    .app-btn svg { width: 22px; height: 22px; }

    .app-promo-visual {
      flex: 0 0 320px;
      position: relative;
    }

    .phone-mockup {
      width: 280px;
      height: 560px;
      background: var(--navy);
      border-radius: 36px;
      padding: 12px;
      box-shadow: var(--shadow-xl);
      margin: 0 auto;
      position: relative;
    }

    .phone-screen {
      width: 100%;
      height: 100%;
      background: var(--white);
      border-radius: 26px;
      overflow: hidden;
      display: flex;
      flex-direction: column;
    }

    .phone-status-bar {
      height: 44px;
      background: var(--navy);
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
      padding-top: 10px;
    }

    .phone-notch {
      width: 120px;
      height: 28px;
      background: var(--navy-dark);
      border-radius: 0 0 16px 16px;
    }

    .phone-content {
      flex: 1;
      padding: 20px 16px;
      display: flex;
      flex-direction: column;
      gap: 16px;
    }

    .phone-greeting {
      font-size: 11px;
      color: var(--gray-500);
    }

    .phone-title {
      font-size: 18px;
      font-weight: 800;
      color: var(--navy);
      line-height: 1.2;
    }

    .phone-search-bar {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 8px;
      padding: 10px 12px;
      background: var(--gray-100);
      border-radius: 10px;
      font-size: 12px;
      color: var(--gray-400);
    }

    .phone-card {
      background: var(--gray-50);
      border-radius: 12px;
      padding: 12px;
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 10px;
    }

    .phone-card-avatar {
      width: 36px;
      height: 36px;
      border-radius: 10px;
      background: var(--navy);
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
      color: var(--yellow);
      font-size: 14px;
      font-weight: 700;
      flex-shrink: 0;
    }

    .phone-card-name { font-size: 12px; font-weight: 700; color: var(--navy); }
    .phone-card-spec { font-size: 10px; color: var(--gray-500); }
    .phone-card-rating { font-size: 10px; color: var(--yellow); margin-top: 2px; }

    .phone-book-btn {

    // Mobile menu toggle

    const overlay = document.getElementById('mobileOverlay');

    function closeMenu() {
      hamburger.classList.remove('active');
      drawer.classList.remove('open');
      overlay.classList.remove('open');
      hamburger.setAttribute('aria-expanded', 'false');
      document.body.style.overflow = '';
    }

    hamburger.addEventListener('click', () => {
      const isOpen = drawer.classList.toggle('open');
      hamburger.classList.toggle('active');
      overlay.classList.toggle('open');
      hamburger.setAttribute('aria-expanded', isOpen);
      document.body.style.overflow = isOpen ? 'hidden' : '';
    });

    overlay.addEventListener('click', closeMenu);

    // Header scroll effect
    const header = document.getElementById('header');
    window.addEventListener('scroll', () => {
      header.classList.toggle('scrolled', window.scrollY > 10);
    }, { passive: true });

    // Autocomplete
    const specialtyInput = document.getElementById('specialty');
    const dropdown = document.getElementById('specialtyDropdown');

    const suggestions = [
      { label: 'Primary Care', type: 'Specialty', icon: '♥' },
      { label: 'Dentist', type: 'Specialty', icon: '☺' },
      { label: 'Dermatologist', type: 'Specialty', icon: '✦' },
      { label: 'Psychiatrist', type: 'Specialty', icon: '☾' },
      { label: 'Eye Doctor', type: 'Specialty', icon: '◉' },
      { label: 'Orthopedic Surgeon', type: 'Specialty', icon: '✚' },
      { label: 'Cardiologist', type: 'Specialty', icon: '♥' },
      { label: 'Back pain', type: 'Condition', icon: '⛟' },
      { label: 'Headache', type: 'Condition', icon: '⛟' },
      { label: 'Skin rash', type: 'Condition', icon: '⛟' },
      { label: 'Dr. Sarah Chen', type: 'Doctor', icon: '⚗' },
      { label: 'Dr. Michael Ross', type: 'Doctor', icon: '⚗' },
    ];

    specialtyInput.addEventListener('input', () => {
      const val = specialtyInput.value.toLowerCase().trim();
      if (!val) { dropdown.classList.remove('show'); return; }

      const filtered = suggestions.filter(s => s.label.toLowerCase().includes(val));
      if (!filtered.length) { dropdown.classList.remove('show'); return; }

      dropdown.innerHTML = filtered.map(s => `
        <div class="autocomplete-item" data-value="${s.label}">
          <div class="item-icon">${s.icon}</div>
          <div>
            <div class="item-label">${s.label}</div>
            <div class="item-type">${s.type}</div>
          </div>
        </div>
      `).join('');

      dropdown.classList.add('show');
    });

    dropdown.addEventListener('click', (e) => {
      const item = e.target.closest('.autocomplete-item');
      if (item) {
        specialtyInput.value = item.dataset.value;
        dropdown.classList.remove('show');
      }
    });

    document.addEventListener('click', (e) => {
      if (!e.target.closest('.search-field')) dropdown.classList.remove('show');
    });

    // Close autocomplete on Escape
    specialtyInput.addEventListener('keydown', (e) => {
      if (e.key === 'Escape') dropdown.classList.remove('show');
    });

    // Specialty card click
    document.querySelectorAll('.specialty-card').forEach(card => {
      card.addEventListener('click', (e) => {
        e.preventDefault();
        const specialty = card.dataset.specialty;
        specialtyInput.value = specialty;
        window.scrollTo({ top: 0, behavior: 'smooth' });
        setTimeout(() => specialtyInput.focus(), 600);
      });
    });

    // Scroll animations
    const fadeEls = document.querySelectorAll('.fade-up');
    const observer = new IntersectionObserver((entries) => {
      entries.forEach((entry, i) => {
        if (entry.isIntersecting) {
          setTimeout(() => entry.target.classList.add('visible'), i * 80);
          observer.unobserve(entry.target);
        }
      });
    }, { threshold: 0.15, rootMargin: '0px 0px -40px 0px' });

    fadeEls.forEach(el => observer.observe(el));
  </script>
</body>
</html>

      drawer.classList.remove('open');

    hamburger.addEventListener('click', () => {
      const isOpen = drawer.classList.toggle('open');
      hamburger.classList.toggle('active');
      overlay.classList.toggle('open');
      hamburger.setAttribute('aria-expanded', isOpen);
      document.body.style.overflow = isOpen ? 'hidden' : '';
    });

    overlay.addEventListener('click', closeMenu);

    // Header scroll effect
    const header = document.getElementById('header');
    window.addEventListener('scroll', () => {
      header.classList.toggle('scrolled', window.scrollY > 10);
    }, { passive: true });

    // Autocomplete
    const specialtyInput = document.getElementById('specialty');
    const dropdown = document.getElementById('specialtyDropdown');

    const suggestions = [
      { label: 'Primary Care', type: 'Specialty', icon: '♥' },
      { label: 'Dentist', type: 'Specialty', icon: '☺' },
      { label: 'Dermatologist', type: 'Specialty', icon: '✦' },
      { label: 'Psychiatrist', type: 'Specialty', icon: '☾' },
      { label: 'Eye Doctor', type: 'Specialty', icon: '◉' },

      { label: 'Dr. Michael Ross', type: 'Doctor', icon: '⚗' },
    ];

      const val = specialtyInput.value.toLowerCase().trim();
      if (!val) { dropdown.classList.remove('show'); return; }

      const filtered = suggestions.filter(s => s.label.toLowerCase().includes(val));
      if (!filtered.length) { dropdown.classList.remove('show'); return; }

      dropdown.innerHTML = filtered.map(s => `
        <div class="autocomplete-item" data-value="${s.label}">
          <div class="item-icon">${s.icon}</div>
          <div>
            <div class="item-label">${s.label}</div>
            <div class="item-type">${s.type}</div>
          </div>
        </div>
      `).join('');

      dropdown.classList.add('show');
    });

    dropdown.addEventListener('click', (e) => {
      const item = e.target.closest('.autocomplete-item');
      if (item) {
        specialtyInput.value = item.dataset.value;
        dropdown.classList.remove('show');
      }
    });

    document.addEventListener('click', (e) => {
      if (!e.target.closest('.search-field')) dropdown.classList.remove('show');
    });

    // Close autocomplete on Escape
    specialtyInput.addEventListener('keydown', (e) => {
      if (e.key === 'Escape') dropdown.classList.remove('show');
    });

    // Specialty card click
    document.querySelectorAll('.specialty-card').forEach(card => {
      card.addEventListener('click', (e) => {
        e.preventDefault();
        const specialty = card.dataset.specialty;
        specialtyInput.value = specialty;
        window.scrollTo({ top: 0, behavior: 'smooth' });
        setTimeout(() => specialtyInput.focus(), 600);
      });
    });

    // Scroll animations
    const fadeEls = document.querySelectorAll('.fade-up');
    const observer = new IntersectionObserver((entries) => {
      entries.forEach((entry, i) => {
        if (entry.isIntersecting) {
          setTimeout(() => entry.target.classList.add('visible'), i * 80);
          observer.unobserve(entry.target);
        }
      });
    }, { threshold: 0.15, rootMargin: '0px 0px -40px 0px' });

    fadeEls.forEach(el => observer.observe(el));
  </script>
